3x+5=14.spoken_detailed: The whole equation. It says that the left side, 3x plus 5, has the same value as the right side, 14.

children.spoken_detailed: The left side of the equation, everything before the equals sign. It reads 3x plus 5. Addition. It combines the term 3x and the constant 5 by adding them.
children.spoken_context: The addition expression 3x plus 5 forms the left side of the equation. The right side is 14.

children.spoken_detailed: Multiplication. It combines the coefficient 3 and the variable x by multiplying them. So 3x means 3 times x.
children.spoken_context: The term 3x is added to the constant 5. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 3 is the coefficient of x. It tells you x is multiplied by 3, so the term means 3 times x.
children.spoken_context: The coefficient 3 belongs to the variable x: x is multiplied by 3. Together they form the term 3x.

children.spoken_detailed: x is the variable. It stands for an unknown number, the value we want to find. Here it is multiplied by the coefficient 3.
children.spoken_context: The variable x is multiplied by the coefficient 3. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 5 is a constant term: a plain number that does not multiply x. It is added to the term 3x.
children.spoken_context: The constant term 5 is added to the term 3x. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: The right side of the equation, everything after the equals sign. It is just the number 14.
children.spoken_context: The number 14 forms the right side of the equation. The left side is 3x plus 5.

children.spoken_context: The addition expression 2x plus 3 forms the left side of the equation. The right side is 9.

children.spoken_detailed: Multiplication. It combines the coefficient 2 and the variable x by multiplying them. So 2x means 2 times x.
children.spoken_context: The term 2x is added to the constant 3. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 2 is the coefficient of x. It tells you x is multiplied by 2, so the term means 2 times x.
children.spoken_context: The coefficient 2 belongs to the variable x: x is multiplied by 2. Together they form the term 2x.

children.spoken_detailed: x is the variable. It stands for an unknown number, the value we want to find. Here it is multiplied by the coefficient 2.
children.spoken_context: The variable x is multiplied by the coefficient 2. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 3 is a constant term: a plain number that does not multiply x. It is added to the term 2x.

2(x+3)=12.spoken_detailed: The whole equation. It says that the left side, 2 times the group x plus 3 end group, has the same value as the right side, 12.

children.spoken_detailed: The left side of the equation, everything before the equals sign. It reads 2 times the group x plus 3 end group. Multiplication. It combines the multiplier 2 and the group x plus 3 by multiplying them. So 2 multiplies the entire group x plus 3.
children.spoken_context: The multiplication expression 2 times the group x plus 3 forms the left side of the equation. The right side is 12.

children.spoken_detailed: 2 is the multiplier of the group x plus 3. It multiplies the entire group x plus 3, so every part inside the brackets is multiplied by 2. It is not a coefficient, because it multiplies a group and not the variable.
children.spoken_context: The multiplier 2 multiplies the entire group x plus 3. Together they form the product 2 times the group x plus 3. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: Group. The group contains x plus 3, which is treated as one quantity. The group is the brackets as a whole, and the sum x plus 3 is the expression inside it. The entire group is multiplied by the multiplier 2.
children.spoken_context: The group x plus 3 is multiplied by the multiplier 2. It is treated as one quantity. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: Addition. It combines the variable x and the constant 3 by adding them. It is the content of the group, enclosed by its brackets.
children.spoken_context: The sum x plus 3 is the content of the group, enclosed by its brackets.

children.spoken_detailed: x is the variable. It stands for an unknown number, the value we want to find.
children.spoken_context: The variable x is added to the constant 3. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 3 is a constant term: a plain number that does not multiply x. It is added to the variable x.
children.spoken_context: The constant term 3 is added to the variable x. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: The right side of the equation, everything after the equals sign. It is just the number 12.
children.spoken_context: The number 12 forms the right side of the equation. The left side is 2 times the group x plus 3.

x^2+3=7.spoken_detailed: The whole equation. It says that the left side, x to the power of 2, plus 3, has the same value as the right side, 7.

children.spoken_detailed: The left side of the equation, everything before the equals sign. It reads x to the power of 2, plus 3. Addition. It combines the expression x to the power of 2 and the constant 3 by adding them.
children.spoken_context: The addition expression x to the power of 2, plus 3 forms the left side of the equation. The right side is 7.

children.spoken_detailed: Power. The base is x and the exponent is 2. x squared means x is multiplied by itself: x times x.
children.spoken_context: The expression x to the power of 2 is added to the constant 3. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: x is the variable. It stands for an unknown number, the value we want to find. It is the base, raised to the power 2.
children.spoken_context: The variable x is the base, raised to the power 2.

children.spoken_detailed: 2 is the exponent. It indicates that x is multiplied by itself. It is not a constant term or a coefficient: it is not added to anything and does not multiply anything. It only says how many times the base is multiplied.
children.spoken_context: The exponent 2 belongs to the base x. Together they form x to the power of 2.

children.spoken_detailed: 3 is a constant term: a plain number that does not multiply x. It is added to the expression x to the power of 2.
children.spoken_context: The constant term 3 is added to the expression x to the power of 2. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: The right side of the equation, everything after the equals sign. It is just the number 7.
children.spoken_context: The number 7 forms the right side of the equation. The left side is x to the power of 2, plus 3.

(x+1)/2=3.spoken_detailed: The whole equation. It says that the left side, the fraction with numerator x plus 1 and denominator 2, has the same value as the right side, 3.

children.spoken_detailed: The left side of the equation, everything before the equals sign. It reads the fraction with numerator x plus 1 and denominator 2. Fraction. It has x plus 1 as its numerator and 2 as its denominator. The numerator is the top part and the denominator is the bottom part, so the fraction means the quantity x plus 1 divided by 2.
children.spoken_context: The fraction with numerator x plus 1 and denominator 2 forms the left side of the equation. The right side is 3.

children.spoken_detailed: Addition. It combines the variable x and the constant 1 by adding them. It is the numerator of a fraction whose denominator is 2.
children.spoken_context: The sum x plus 1 is the numerator of a fraction whose denominator is 2.

children.spoken_detailed: x is the variable. It stands for an unknown number, the value we want to find.
children.spoken_context: The variable x is added to the constant 1. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 1 is a constant term: a plain number that does not multiply x. It is added to the variable x.
children.spoken_context: The constant term 1 is added to the variable x. It is part of the left side of the equation.

children.spoken_detailed: 2 is the denominator of the fraction: the bottom part, which the numerator x plus 1 is divided by. A denominator cannot be zero.
children.spoken_context: The denominator 2 divides the numerator x plus 1. Together they form the fraction with numerator x plus 1 and denominator 2.

children.spoken_detailed: The right side of the equation, everything after the equals sign. It is just the number 3.
children.spoken_context: The number 3 forms the right side of the equation. The left side is the fraction with numerator x plus 1 and denominator 2.
